name: get_location
description: Get the user's current city and country. Call this when a request refers to the user's location ("here", "where I am") without naming a place.

name: get_weather
description: Get the current weather for a city.

city.description: The city to get the weather for.

name: list_rooms
description: List the rooms with a speaker, each with its room ID and name. Call this before set_volume if you don't already know the room's ID from this conversation.

name: set_volume
description: Set the speaker volume in a room to an exact level.
